top_signals.title: Australia Passes Landmark Law to Reserve Gas for Domestic Consumers
top_signals.summary: The Australian parliament today passed a law that would mandate LNG exporters to set aside gas equivalent to up to 20% of their annual export volumes for the domestic market, beginning in 2028.
